title: DSH native PTC Release Bundle manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: Contract for team/ptc/releases/<releaseId>/release-manifest.json. Byte-level integrity is owned by plugins/dsh-ptc-control-plane/lib/release-integrity.js; this schema freezes the document shape only. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express (path sort order, path uniqueness, bundleDigest binding, snapshot coverage, verification consistency, previousReleaseId != releaseId) are enforced by plugins/dsh-ptc-control-plane/test/release-manifest-schema.test.mjs.

schemaVersion.description: Frozen manifest contract version; any contract change requires a new schemaVersion.

releaseId.description: Release identity; matches the bundle directory name, e.g. ptc-release-v1.

createdAt.description: RFC 3339 publish timestamp. format is annotation-only in draft 2020-12; the schema test asserts it, and consumers must enable format assertion.

previousReleaseId.description: Previous release kept for rollback; null for the first release. Must differ from releaseId (enforced by tests).

snapshots.description: The five frozen snapshot categories. The union of all listed paths must equal the files[].path set, with every file declared in exactly one category (enforced by tests).

profiles.description: Agent profile snapshots (instructions, boundaries, output contracts, cases).

orchestration.description: Orchestration snapshots: ptc_stage_registry snapshot, Captain entry and stage advancement rules.

policies.description: Dispatcher identity and key policy/gate script snapshots.

verification.description: Verification evidence: single-agent evaluation and full pipeline regression results.

files.description: Every bundled file except release-manifest.json itself, listed strictly ascending by path (ordering enforced by tests).

path.description: POSIX-style relative path: no leading slash, no backslash, no '..' segment. Mirrors lib/release-integrity.js path rules.

size.description: Exact on-disk byte size, bounded by Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of the exact on-disk bytes, per team/ptc/HASH_CONTRACT.md.

bundleDigest.description: Lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of the canonical file list, computed by lib/release-integrity.js#digestReleaseEntries over files[]. The manifest never hashes itself.

releaseVerification.description: Release verification conclusion recorded at publish time. result 'passed' requires both sub-conclusions 'passed' (enforced by tests).
